Talk about getting run out of the building.

Not long after the start of what turned into a 56-26 loss to Oregon State on Saturday in Fort Collins, Colo., Colorado State defensive coordinator Tyson Summers was nowhere to be found.

When the game finally ended, Rams coach Jim Mora said Summers was, in fact, no longer with the team.

“That is a permanent move that was made following tonight’s game,” Mora said.

Mora, in his first year with the Rams, said he had relieved Summers of his play-calling duties in the first half, though telling him to leave the sideline “wasn’t anything that I would ever consider.”

“He made the decision on his own to leave the field,” Mora said, “and he is no longer with the program.”
